nuggets.text: The Jaguars' first game at Hancock Whitney Stadium was against Tulane on Sept. 12, 2020, six years to the day before this one.
The Jaguars held the ball for 40:09 in their opener, a program record for time of possession.
Jaguars kicker Davis Little made a career-high four field goals in the win over Southeastern Louisiana.
Three Jaguars running backs reached 60 yards in the opener: PJ Martin, Keenan Phillips and Trae'von Dunbar.
Jaguars coach Major Applewhite threw for a Texas-record 473 yards to win MVP of the 2001 Holiday Bowl.
Major is Jaguars coach Major Applewhite's real first name, not a military rank.
Major Applewhite set 48 school records as a quarterback at Texas.
The Jaguars started playing football in 2009 and became the youngest FBS team to reach a bowl game in 2014.
The Jaguars award the No. 5 jersey to senior leaders to honor the legacy of running back Anthony Mostella.
The Jaguars have not one but two mascots: SouthPaw and Mrs. Pawla.
